notes.title: Combat Update & Visual Improvements – July 2025
notes.notes:
We've refined several aspects of the system to deliver a more intense, fluid, and realistic experience:

Improved physics when eliminating zombies: ragdolls are now activated for more natural deaths.

Enemies fall with more force when defeated, depending on the intensity of the final blow.

New visual effects when hitting skeletons and casting fire spells.

Enemy projectiles now feature more spectacular and clearer visual effects during combat.

Adjusted haptic feedback on swords and shields when attacking, blocking, or deflecting projectiles.

Enhanced hit detection: collisions with enemies are now more accurate and satisfying.

The fearsome spectral spiders in Level 4 are now more aggressive, making the level a real challenge.

The main menu camera has been slightly zoomed in to improve text readability.

Thank you for playing! We're continuing to improve Tales of Sintra with every update.

notes.title: Release of Tales of Sintra
notes.notes:
The wait is over.

On February 27th, Ippo Games presents Tales of Sintra: The Dark Vortex. An action and adventure title for Virtual Reality where you'll discover a world consumed by shadows.

The forces of evil have unleashed the Dark Vortex, a voracious entity that absorbs and destroys all light in its path, threatening to plunge the world into eternal darkness.

Highlighted Features:

Immersive Environments:
Immerse yourself in a world of darkness that comes to life with beautifully detailed environments. From sinister dungeons to imposing fortresses, each corner is meticulously designed to offer a unique visual experience.

Versatile Combat:
Master the art of the sword, bow, shield, and spells. Configure your preferred combat style and face a variety of enemies, from undead and ogres to imposing dragons.

Challenging Puzzles:
Beyond brute force, players must use their wits to overcome puzzles. Find creative solutions to advance the story.

Runes and Spells:
Unlock magical power by collecting runes scattered throughout the world. Face powerful guardians to unlock spells that will change the course of the battle.

Duration and Soundtrack:
With a gameplay duration of over 8 hours, Tales of Sintra immerses you in an epic experience backed by more than 35 captivating musical compositions.

Price:
Tales of Sintra will be available for 19.99 euros, though it will have a discount during the first few days after its launch..

Can light defeat darkness? Discover it in Tales of Sintra: The Dark Vortex!
